name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 48 – Am 4
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 48a. Calls for the dismantling of EU-supported fact-checking organisations and networks; warns that institutionalised fact-checking risks undermining freedom of expression, media pluralism and open democratic debate; calls for the EU to favour transparency, free media and the exchange of ideas over publicly endorsed fact-checking structures, and to scrutinise the funding of organisations involved in politically sensitive fact-checking activities;
